description: Section 6 — Senior-friendly (50s-club) UI/UX standards. Apply a minimalist, clutter-free, high-contrast style with a large base font (16px-18px) and large touch targets for buttons and inputs, comfortable on both phone and PC. This is a cross-cutting styling pass on the existing theme and shell; it should not change business logic. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 logic but should be done after them so it styles the new surfaces too.
steps: In style.css, raise the base/body font-size to 16px-18px and bump the type scale for common text (table cells, labels, buttons, form inputs) so nothing critical reads below ~14px. Do this via existing CSS custom properties / a small set of tokens where possible rather than scattering overrides.

Increase touch-target sizing: buttons (.btn, .btn-ghost, .action-primary, .action-edit), form controls (.form-input, .form-select), and nav rail/subnav items to a minimum ~44px tap height with comfortable padding. Keep layout intact.

Improve contrast: verify text vs background meets a high-contrast bar in both dark (default) and [data-theme=light] blocks; nudge muted/label colors darker/lighter as needed. Keep the emerald primary.
Mirror the relevant sizing overrides in mobile.css so phones get the same large, clutter-free treatment; ensure large targets on <=768px.
app.html: if base font or key control sizing is set inline there, align it with the new tokens. Do not restructure the shell.

Verify the new FEAT-002/003/004 screens (weighbridge, reconciliation, funnels, custom report, daily-entry) inherit the larger type and targets; adjust any screen-specific inline styles that hardcode tiny fonts (e.g. font-size:11px) up to the new floor where they carry meaningful content.
No new logic tests required, but run the full suite to confirm no test that asserts DOM/text broke. If a smoke test inspects styles, keep it green.
acceptance_criteria: Base font is 16px-18px; primary interactive text is not smaller than ~14px.
Buttons and form inputs have ~44px minimum tap height with comfortable padding, on desktop and mobile.
High contrast maintained in both dark and light themes.
The pipeline/funnel/report/daily-entry surfaces render with the enlarged type and targets.
`npm run test:run`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` all pass.
findings: Committed as 1c92958. Verification: npm run test:run 255/255 pass (21 files); npm run lint clean (only the harmless .eslintignore-deprecation warning); npm run build succeeds; npm run type-check shows exactly the 12 known pre-existing errors (11 rbac.test.ts + 1 twofa-flow.test.ts), zero new. NEW SURFACES: pipeline-extras reconciliation list + weighbridge entry grid inline fonts 11/12px->13/14px and inputs widened; funnel-report TH/TD 11/12px->13/14px, filter labels 11px->14px, funnel bar labels/counts bumped; dashboard funnel fallbacks + margin/piutang captions 11/12px->13/14px; entri-harian task desc 12px->13px. No business logic changed.
